questions.q: After how long does Betaflight consider the signal lost?
questions.explain: 100 ms — loss, 300 ms — holding the last values, then Stage 1.
The parameter is in tenths of a second.

questions.q: What does the DROP procedure do?
questions.explain: Motors stop; re-arming is possible after the link returns, the failsafe_recovery_delay wait, and with the arm switch off.

questions.q: What does Betaflight do with ANGLE mode in Stage 2 (AUTO-LAND)?
options: Enables it by itself if an accelerometer is present
Nothing: ANGLE is set only by the channel
Disables it so it doesn't interfere with the descent
Enables it only with a GPS fix
questions.explain: In Stage 2 the firmware enables ANGLE by itself (fc/core.c) if there is an accelerometer; without an accelerometer there's nothing to level with — such an aircraft is better set to DROP.

questions.q: Which switch mode most honestly reproduces a link loss?
questions.explain: STAGE1 goes through both stages, as in a real signal loss.

questions.q: What's dangerous about KILL on a switch?
options: It enables GPS Rescue instead of disarming
A channel glitch means an instant disarm
questions.explain: KILL disarms with no delay — any channel glitch drops the drone.

questions.q: How do you pick failsafe_throttle for AUTO-LAND?
options: Always 1500 — the middle of the throttle range
questions.explain: Slightly below hover throttle from the log, aiming for about 1 m/s descent: on a heavy 10" it might be 1350, on a light 7" — 1250.
a — auto, h — hold, s — set; for example, to enable ANGLE.

questions.q: What does GPS Rescue need to record home?
options: A fix with the required number of satellites
A working barometer and accelerometer calibration
questions.explain: A fix with ≥ gps_rescue_min_sats before arming. Without home, Rescue is useless; leave allow_arming_without_fix OFF.

questions.q: The aircraft won't arm. What does this status output mean?
questions.fragment:
# status
...
Arming disable flags: RXLOSS CLI
options: No valid RC frames, and the CLI is open — arming is blocked for both reasons
The accelerometer isn't calibrated: the RXLOSS flag appears when ACC calibration is missing
The aircraft is tilted more than small_angle, which is encoded by the CLI flag
GPS Rescue mode is on without a satellite fix — that's what the RXLOSS and CLI flags mean
questions.explain: RXLOSS — no RC frames; CLI — arming is deliberately blocked while the CLI is open.
